title: When a chief executive sorts it out, what changes for the next family?
summary: A chief executive gets a family the help it has been waiting for. Who has the authority to change the rule that held it up?

title: How much of your successful project is being held together by somebody else’s unpaid work?
summary: A neighbourhood project can look affordable because families cover costs that never appear in its accounts. Who could challenge those figures before the money is committed?

source: The Necessary Tangle · Collected sayings and sources
title: Heinz von Foerster: said to someone
summary: Where did Heinz von Foerster say that, and to whom? Recordings and recollections sometimes give different versions. There’s also an imagined conversation with Captain Beefheart.
